summary: Icons are essential for communicating our brand in all areas. Both static and animated, they help convey information and enhance the user experience.
principles: Use icons as essential brand communication elements
Support information transfer and UX clarity
Differentiate static and animated icon applications
ai_meaning: Treat icons as part of Bosch brand expression, not merely decorative UI elements.
Select or generate icons to clarify meaning, improve orientation, and reduce cognitive load for users.
When creating or selecting assets, distinguish between static icon use cases and animated icon use cases instead of treating them as one asset type.

generation_fields.semantic_intent: The user meaning the icon should communicate
generation_fields.context_of_use: UI, presentation, campaign, product communication, documentation, etc.
generation_fields.style_constraints: Bosch brand-consistent, simple, clear, functional, not ornamental
generation_fields.accessibility_label: Text alternative or aria-label when used in UI
generation_fields.format: SVG preferred for production icons; PNG may be used for previews or presentations
generation_fields.motion_specification: For animated icons, define loop behavior, duration, easing, and trigger condition

do_not_overinfer: Do not assume exact Bosch icon grid, stroke width, or animation timing from this page alone.
Do not recreate proprietary icon assets directly unless the user has permission and provides the needed source assets.
Do not treat the preview PNGs as complete production specifications.
direction: Generate icon concepts that are simple, functional, brand-aligned, and optimized for clarity; validate final assets against the official Bosch icon library before production use.
